$comment: Coverage floors for logic directories (ADR 0043). Read by scripts/ci/coverage-gate.mjs, which the go, vitest and pytest test targets run. A floor is the rounded-down coverage measured on 2026-09-20 (Go statements, Vitest and pytest lines) and only goes up: run the gate with --update after adding tests. Any new logic directory starts at 80; a lower floor needs a written reason. UI components, host glue and sidecar-launch code are not listed on purpose: Go packages root, cmd, assets, guide, process, settings, transcript, tts, whisper; apps/ui components and the Wails client; the teleprompter live_asr engines; release scripts.

entries.reason: Was 100 at baseline (#342). The remaining uncovered statements are the permission-denied error paths in scopeFiles/readScope (an analyzer folder or scope file that exists but cannot be read). Tests simulate them with an icacls deny rule, but CI runs elevated and Go opens files with backup semantics, so the deny is not enforced there and those tests skip; they only run on a non-elevated Windows machine. 96.2% measured without them; rounded down to 96.
EPUB import added in txt-and-epub p2; 92.4% measured

Baseline of 2026-09-20 (73.2%). The service and reader carry file and progress plumbing that is exercised end to end, not unit by unit; the ratchet stops it falling and each change here should raise it.

Baseline of 2026-09-20 was 69.2%; deleting the dead client/http.ts (0%) in the Knip cleanup lifted it to 71%. The directory still mixes the mock API (test infrastructure, 65%) and the Wails client glue (34%), so it is gated to stop the tested part decaying and the floor rises with tests.

Baseline of 2026-09-20 was 61%; the Hypothesis properties of phase 4 lifted it to 69%. config.py (69%), logging_utils.py (50%) and progress.py (12%) still have little coverage; the floor rises as they get tests.
Baseline of 2026-09-20 (71%). The entity and pronunciation logic sits beside Piper and spaCy calls that need the real models; the ratchet stops it falling.

Baseline of 2026-09-20 was 14%; the Hypothesis properties of phase 4 (tokenizing, number merging, sentence splitting) lifted it to 20%, the marker and golden tests of recording-coverage phase 2 to 38%, and the coverage-mode helpers of phase 3 to 42%. Decoding, transcription (chunked included) and the CLI paths are still untested in process (the --coverage CLI tests run it as a subprocess, which is not measured); the floor rises as they get tests.

The recording-coverage ground-truth harness (recording-coverage-analysis PRD Phase 1). It lives under tests/ because it is test tooling, but Phase 8 calibrates the shipped thresholds with it, so it is gated like logic. 99.7% measured; the one uncovered line is the script entry point.
